what: identity of the published source with a commit of the league's working repository, checked when this repository was assembled; and which commit the official judge jobs measured

judged_commit.what: the commit the official judge jobs measured
judged_commit.comment_check: every added or removed line in the changed non-test files is blank or starts with //

mode_difference.why: upstream stores this script with its executable bit; the league's working repository was kept on a file system without mode bits. It is the only reason the two git tree ids differ.

check_1: every blob id and path of the last replayed commit equals those of the working commit 8f9372b named under source_equals (git ls-tree -r), and the file modes differ in the one file named under mode_difference
check_2: SHA-256 of every file of the last replayed commit compared with `git archive` of the working commit 8f9372b
scope: files, all_equal and digest_sha256 describe the last replayed commit, the parent of the commit that adds README.md, .gitattributes and league/. That last commit renames the upstream README to README.upstream.md and changes no file under cmd/, internal/ or helpers/ and no root build file.
digest_definition: sha256 over lines 'path NUL sha256(file) LF' for all files, sorted by path
